scripts.build:adaptive-worker: npm run build --workspace @flaggo/sdk && npm run manifest:adaptive-worker && tsc -p examples/adaptive-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:tetris-integration: npm run build --workspace @flaggo/sdk && npm run manifest:tetris && tsc examples/tetris-integration/generated/catalog.ts --outDir examples/tetris-integration/dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck
scripts.build:otel-evidence: npm run build --workspace @flaggo/sdk && npm run manifest:otel-evidence && tsc examples/otel-evidence/generated/catalog.ts --outDir examples/otel-evidence/dist --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target es2022 --skipLibCheck
scripts.test:adaptive-worker: npm run build:adaptive-worker && dotnet build Flaggo.slnx -c Debug --no-restore && node examples/adaptive-worker/smoke.mjs
scripts.test:otel-evidence: npm run build:otel-evidence && dotnet build Flaggo.slnx -c Debug --no-restore && node examples/otel-evidence/run.mjs
scripts.test:tetris-integration: npm run build:tetris-integration && dotnet build Flaggo.slnx -c Debug --no-restore && node examples/tetris-integration/run.mjs
